description: Frozen CLI exit codes. 0 = success; 1 = user/config/runtime error (bad args, missing key, unknown id, failed verification, locked/corrupt store); 3 = TOS consent required. `check-contracts --exit` runs the probes below against the real CLI and asserts the observed code.

codes.meaning: user/config/runtime error (bad args, missing key, unknown id, failed verification, E_DB_LOCKED/E_DB_CORRUPT)
TOS consent required (E_TOS_REQUIRED); run `advisers tos accept` or pass --accept-tos / ADVISERS_ACCEPT_TOS=1

probeEnv: Every probe runs with a temporary ADVISERS_HOME, ADVISERS_CORE_LOCAL=1, ADVISERS_OFFICE_LOCAL=1, ADVISERS_NO_MODEL=1 and no credentials. Accepted-home probes also set ADVISERS_ACCEPT_TOS=1 (the documented non-interactive consent flag).

probes.note: evidence verify is TOS-exempt and reports {ok:false} on stdout (not the error envelope).

knownGaps.note: Strict option parsing landed in 0.3.0 for the operational commands (status, export, audit, doctor, backup, backups, restore): an unknown flag fails with E_USAGE and exit 1. Older commands (for example `today --json --bogus` or `commit ls --json --bogus`) still ignore unknown flags, so v1 does NOT guarantee strict-flag exit 1 for every command (documented in docs/CONTRACTS.md).
